## 📝 Summary
Describe the problem and user-visible change.

## 🔄 Change type
- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Feature
- [ ] UI/UX or accessibility
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Security/dependency
- [ ] Maintenance

## 🧩 Implementation
List the main files/components changed and any design/data contract decisions.

## ✅ Verification
- [ ] `npm ci`
- [ ] `npm run lint`
- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] `npm run build`
- [ ] `python scripts/validate_repo.py`
- [ ] `python scripts/validate_docs.py`
- [ ] Manual browser checks for affected flows
- [ ] CI results reviewed

## 🔐 Privacy and security
- [ ] No secrets, credentials, or real employee records added
- [ ] Public JSON and production build reviewed for sensitive values
- [ ] Dependency/security implications reviewed
- [ ] No frontend-only behavior described as access control

## ♿ Accessibility and responsive behavior
- [ ] Semantic controls and accessible names checked
- [ ] Keyboard and focus behavior checked
- [ ] Reduced motion and responsive layouts considered
- [ ] Contrast or screen-reader impact reviewed where relevant

## 📚 Documentation and visuals
- [ ] README/docs updated where behavior changed
- [ ] Mermaid diagrams and SVG references still match the code
- [ ] Internal Markdown links checked
- [ ] Screenshots, when included, come from a real build and use synthetic data

## 📸 Evidence
Attach sanitized screenshots, test logs, or workflow links. Do not attach confidential employee information.

## ⚠️ Known limitations
List untested areas, follow-up work, and any accepted risk.
